plan.goal: Design a de novo 85-residue soluble protein using RFdiffusion backbone generation, ProteinMPNN inverse folding, Protenix structure prediction, structure analysis, protein QC, and ranking; return the top-ranked sequence with rationale.
assumptions: Unconditional backbone generation mode is appropriate; no target, motif, or symmetry constraint was specified.
85 residues is within RFdiffusion's reliable unconditional generation range for globular soluble proteins.
ProteinMPNN temperature 0.1 (low diversity, high fidelity) is used; can be raised to 0.2–0.3 if diversity is later desired.
Protenix runs without MSA (use_msa=false) for speed; a de novo sequence has no meaningful MSA at this stage anyway.
QC filters applied: pLDDT ≥ 70, GRAVY < 0 (hydrophilic/soluble), instability index < 40, no polybasic patches.
Top-3 candidates are ranked; the single best by composite score is returned as the output sequence.
No ligand, cofactor, or binding partner is required.

success_criteria.rationale: one-paragraph explanation covering backbone quality, sequence composition, predicted fold confidence, and solubility indicators
